landing.heroTitleLine1: Your edge is in your mind
landing.heroSubtitle: 90 seconds. One breath. Your best decision.
landing.featuresIntro: Kognit is with you before, during, and after every moment of tension: guided protocols to lower stress, emotional anchoring habits, coaching cards, a personal journal, and a community training on the same frequency as you.

reset.title: Reset (Protocol)
reset.description: Lower your emotional intensity in 35 or 90 seconds with guided breathing, grounding, and automatic progress tracking.

calmAnchor.title: Calm Anchor
calmAnchor.description: Your personal mental anchor, always within reach on the home screen: breathe, trigger your gesture and phrase, and return to the present in seconds.

cards.title: Mental Cards
cards.description: 50 coaching cards (5 categories x 10) with reflective questions, insights, and practical actions. Free: 1 random card per day. Premium: unlimited access.

journal.title: Journal & Calendar
journal.description: Daily notes with optional images, emotional pattern tracking, and daily trends.

community.title: Community
community.description: Shared reflections, reactions, and private messages. No followers or rankings, just mutual support.

profile.title: Your Progress
profile.description: Focus score, emotional control, streak, XP, and full history to see your evolution.

featuresPage.title: Everything you need to train your mind
featuresPage.subtitle: Every Kognit feature is built for a specific moment: before you start, in the middle of the tension, and afterwards, when it's time to look back at what happened.

cta.title: Try Kognit for free
cta.subtitle: No card. No commitment. Start your first reset in less than a minute.

useCasesPage.title: Kognit adapts to the challenges of your day
useCasesPage.subtitle: Everyone faces different moments of pressure, stress or uncertainty. We start making decisions the moment we wake up. Kognit combines mental training tools to help you observe what's going through your mind, get your clarity back and respond better when it matters most.

demandingRoutine.title: A demanding routine
demandingRoutine.painPoint: Intense days, tasks piling up, and the feeling that one bad moment ruins everything that comes after it.
demandingRoutine.solution: In less than a minute, Kognit helps you bring the tension down, get your focus back and keep stress from making decisions for you.

highPressure.title: High-pressure moments
highPressure.painPoint: A presentation, an interview, an exam or an important decision. When it feels like everything hangs on that one moment.
highPressure.solution: A short training session helps you find your calm before you act, while a Mental Card invites you to observe your thoughts and choose more clearly how to respond.

noSecondChance.title: No second chance
noSecondChance.painPoint: Speaking to an audience, recording a video, leading a meeting or making a final call. There are moments with no replay button.
noSecondChance.solution: Kognit helps you come back to the present in seconds so you can respond with more confidence, and afterwards record the experience to discover how you thought, how you spoke to yourself and what you can do better next time.

badPatch.title: Coming out of a rough patch
badPatch.painPoint: When exhaustion, mistakes or a hard stretch start to eat into your confidence, it's easy to confuse what actually happened with the story you start telling yourself.
badPatch.solution: The Journal and your personal tracking help you recognise patterns, observe your inner dialogue and get back a more objective view so you can keep moving.

cta.title: Do any of these sound like you?
cta.subtitle: Start free and try the reset the next time you need it.

cancel.question: Can I cancel Kognit Pro whenever I want?
cancel.answer: Yes, you can cancel at any time from your profile. You keep Pro access until the end of the period you've already paid for.

trial.question: Is there a Kognit Pro trial period?
trial.answer: The Free plan has no time limit, so you can try the full reset protocol and the community without paying anything before deciding whether you want more.

switch.question: Can I switch from monthly to annual?
switch.answer: Yes, you can change your billing cycle from your profile whenever you like; the new cycle starts with your next payment.

payment.question: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: We process Kognit Pro payments through Mercado Pago, with credit or debit card.

contactPage.title: Got a question?
contactPage.subtitle: Write to us and we'll get back to you shortly. You can also send us a direct email.

proTrialModal.title: Use Kognit Pro free for 6 months!
proTrialModal.description: Join our volunteer team and use the app for testing. In exchange, we give you 6 months of PRO access for free.
proTrialModal.conditions: You need to use the feedback form at least once a week to keep the PRO level on your account.
